stem.en: A forecast says the wind will be a westerly. Which way does it blow?

text.en: From the east towards the west

feedback.en: This wind is heading west, so it would be an easterly.

text.en: From the west towards the east

feedback.en: Yes. A wind is named for the direction it blows from.

text.en: From the north towards the south

feedback.en: That wind would be a northerly.

explanation.en: Winds are named after the direction they blow from. A westerly comes from the west and moves towards the east.

hints.en: The name tells you where the wind comes from.
